items: Twelve kings succeeded one another in Abomey between 1625 and 1900, according to UNESCO.
The Slave Route in Ouidah is about four kilometres long and leads to the Door of No Return.
January 10 is a public holiday dedicated to indigenous religions, also called the vodun festival.
In 2021, France returned twenty-six works from the royal treasures of Abomey to Benin.
Ganvié is a lake village built on stilts, on Lake Nokoué.
The CFA franc is pegged to the euro at a fixed rate: €1 = 655.957 F CFA.
